prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide 2:1 conference slide schematic, same editorial photographic cut-paper collage aesthetic as the reference. Warm ivory #EFEAE0 paper with fine fibers, grayscale photographic object cutouts with cream edges, muted teal #A3CFCB and yellow #FFE234 torn-paper labels, vermilion #E5432F accents, sparse black halftone, shallow natural shadows, bold crisp Archivo-like sans-serif type. Clean, readable at presentation size. No logos, watermark, robot or extra people.
Explain Mailosaur email testing with Cypress, with THREE columns across top: LEFT laptop photo labeled "Cypress test"; CENTER browser/laptop photo labeled "App"; RIGHT grayscale postal inbox photo containing envelopes labeled "Mailosaur inbox". Directly beneath the RIGHT label a small cream note "Dedicated inbox" then "Inbox ID: abc123". abc123 is an illustrative ID, not a credential.
Below headers draw THREE thin dashed vertical lifelines and exactly FOUR horizontal message arrows ordered downward:
1 LEFT Cypress test to CENTER App, short RIGHT-pointing arrow. Label on cream paper "Use test@abc123.mailosaur.net". This shows the test interacting with the app using the dedicated inbox's domain.
2 CENTER App to RIGHT Mailosaur inbox, short RIGHT-pointing arrow. Label "Send email".
3 LEFT Cypress test to RIGHT Mailosaur inbox, long RIGHT-pointing vermilion arrow, passing through center WITHOUT stopping there. Label "cy.mailosaurGetMessage(...)". Smaller line immediately above or below label "Inbox ID + recipient". Spell this command EXACTLY.
4 RIGHT Mailosaur inbox to LEFT Cypress test, long LEFT-pointing black arrow, passing through center WITHOUT stopping. Label "Message content".
Below message rows, a bold large black checklist mark beside a cream torn strip "Assert subject, body, links, codes", positioned under the Cypress side and wide enough to be clear. This final assertion happens IN THE TEST, not in the inbox.
Along the BOTTOM, separated from the main email diagram by generous blank space, two balanced compact photo-collage capability notes: LEFT small grayscale phone cutout with label "SMS testing" and detail "Dedicated number, same message checks"; RIGHT small grayscale authenticator/clock cutout with label "TOTP testing" and detail "Generate code from shared secret". These are additional capabilities; do NOT draw arrows from the email inbox to TOTP, since TOTP codes are generated separately rather than received by email.
No additional text beyond specified labels. Large clear arrowheads point only at their named destinations. No overlaps, no extra connections, no line crossings within one message row. Photo headers compact enough to leave room for four message rows, final assertion strip and bottom capability notes. Collage should be tactile and elegant, with scientific diagram clarity.
